content: Nainugi-arbamalad-isganamar

Geb degine, Jesús dulemarga burbar sunmakdesunnad: “Dule-wargwen nainugi uva-digsad. Ber ebilis emaksad, agi uva-egured-neg sobsad, degi, nakulegega neg-warakgwagad-matusulid sobsabalid. Geb nainu-ibed dule-arbamaladga e-nainu manigi-urmaksad. Nainu-ibeddi dikasur neggwebur-baidse naded.
”Uva-weed-ibagan-mosgu, nainu-ibed na e-mai-wargwen nainugi-arbamaladse barmialid, adi, uva-egadga-gued suegar.
Ar nainugi-arbamaladdi nainu-ibed-e-mai gasmalad, sabsur sarsosmalad, degi, unni-arganagwabi gannar barmismalad.
Geb nainu-ibed e-mai-baid barmiarbalid. Adi, e-ibe nono marismalad, degi, egi dodosmarbalid.
Nainu-ibed gannar e-mai-baid barmiarbalid, adi, oburgwismalad. Deyobi, bukidar maigan-bamalad barmiarbalid. Gwen-gwen sarsosmalad, baigandi oburgwismalad.
”Napi, e-ibe wargwen bedapid, adi, e-machi-sabed. Napidgine, na e-machi-sabed barmialid, ar ade, binsaed: ‘An-machigindi binsaed-nikaadamalo an insaye.’
Ar nainugi-arbamaladdi, na muchub-muchub sogdemalad: ‘We-dule nainu-gaoedid. Anmar oburgwemala. Deyobi, nainu anmargadga guoed.’
Degisoggu, machigwa-gasmarsunnad, degi, oburgwismalad. Geb nainu-dikarba machi-metemalad.”
Jesús dulemar-e-itobukmaladga sogded: “¿Nainu-ibed, igi dulemar-imako be insae? Nonikogu, nainugi-arbamalad-oburgwenonikoed. Geb dule-bamaladga e-nainu urmakoed.
¿Ar bemar Bab-Dummad-Garda absodisurmarsi? Agi weyob sognaid:

Judío-dummagan, degi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, Jesús-burbar-ibmar-sogsad emargi-sunmaknaid magar itosmalad. A-ulale, Jesús-gabi guarmalanad, degi-inigwele, dulemar-dobe-itomalad. Degisoggu, Jesús-akar-imaksasurmalad, geb nadmalad.
Roma-dummadga-mani-galeged-igar
Geb sorbali, Jesúsʼse abar Fariseoʼmar, degi, Herodes-sordamar barmiarmalad, adi, Jesús na e-ibmar-sogedgi egi gwisgumalagar.

Jesúsʼse-nonimargu, ega sogdemalad: —Odurdaked-saila, anmar be-wisdo, be dule-innikigwadid. Be dule-ibmar-sogedba binsaed galesulid, ar ade, be dulemar-e-daklegedgi ataksulid. Ar be napiragwadgi Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maid odurdaked. Be anmarga soge, ¿ar we igar-nuedi, Roma-Dummad-Césarʼye-nugad anmargi-mani-gaed, anmar bennuked?
¿Anmar bennukoe, igi bennuko suli? Ar Jesúsʼdi we-dulemar yamo e-yardakdanimalad-wissoggu, amarga sogded: —¿Ar ibiga bemar yamo an-yardakdanimala? An dakegala, be anga Roma-mani-gwagwen sedamala.
Ega mani senonimalad, geb Jesús ese egichided: —¿Ar wede we-manigi doa-wagar-wilub sii? ¿Doa-nug narmakar naibali? Jesús-abin sogdemalad: —Roma-Dummad-Césarʼye-nugad-e-wagar-wilub sii.

Jesús, abin-imakdegu, ega sogded: —Ar ibmar Césarʼgadir, be Césarʼga ukmardo. Ar ibmar Bab-Dummadgadir, be Bab-Dummadga ukmardo. Ar weyob Jesús ega soge itosmargu, bela dulemar geger Jesús-dake bukusmalad.
Jesúsʼse gannar-durguleged-igar egichismalad
Geb degine, Saduceoʼmar Jesúsʼse nonimalad. Amar sogmalad, dule burgwisale, gannar geg bar durguye. A-ulale, a-igar Jesúsʼse egisdemalad:
—Odurdaked-saila, Moisés anmarga Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar obesad, dule-wargwen burgwisale, degi, mimmi-nikussuli ome-obesale, e-urba a-ome-nikuoye, adi, e-iaga anagan-urbegarye.
Dakargua, machimala na e-gwenadgan-walagugle (7) gumalad. Ia-dummad ome-nikusgu, anagan-urbissuli burgwisad.
E-urba-sorbalid, e-ia-omega-gusad nikunonikid, amba e-iayob mimmi-nikussuli burgwismogad. Amba deyobi e-urba-sorbalid-baid a-ome nikunonimogad.
Bela-e-walagugled (7) a-ome-nikusmaladbiid, anagan-gwen-obessuli burgwismalad. Geb a-sorbali, ome burgwenonimogad.
Ar dule-gannar-durguoed-iba-nonikile, a-omede, ¿doa-omega guosunna, ar ade, bela e-gugledi nikusmaladbiid?
Geb Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Ar bemar we-igar noar-ganimalad. Ar ade, bemar Bab-Dummad-Garda-narmakar-maid wissurmalad, degi, Bab-Dummad-gangued aku-itomarbalid.
Ar dulemar gannar durguarmalale, bar ome-nikunai, degi, sui-nikunai guosurmalad. Ar ade, baliwitur-nibnegginmaladyob gumaloed.

Ar dulemar-gannar-durgued-igarsikdi, ¿bemar Moisés-gardagi-narmakar-maid absodisurmarsi? Deun Moisés sapi-bula-gummakgwichi-dakargu, ese nadgu, igi Bab Dummad ega sogsa-gusa: ‘Ani an Abraham, Isaac, degi, Jacob e-Bab-Dummad gued.’
Bab-Dummad dulemar-burgwarmalad-e-Bab-Dummadsulid, Bab-Dummad dulemar-dula-gudidimalad-e-Bab-Dummadid. Bemar nue-noar sunmakdimalad.
Bab-Dummad-Igar-Mesisad bur-birigined

Garda-Narmaked-Dule-wargwen Jesúsʼse nonikid, geb Jesús Saduceoʼmarbo abin-abin-imaknanai itosad. Ar Jesús nue-yeer Saduceoʼmar-abin-imaksa itossoggu, Jesúsʼse egichialid: —Bela Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maid, ¿igid bur-biriginedi?
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Igar-bur-birigined, wedo: ‘Israel-dulemar be itomar. Anmar-Bab-Dummad, abi unnila Dummad gued.
Bab-Dummad-be-Dummad, bela-belad be-gwagegi, be-san-burbagi, be-binsaedgi, degi, be-ganguedgi be sabgue.’ We bur-igar-biriginedid.
A-igar-sorbalid amba degisaarbalid: ‘Na be-san-sabgueyob, be, dule-baid sabgumoga.’ We-igarmarba bur igar-baid-birigined sated.
Garda-Narmaked-Dule, Jesús-abin sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, nue-napira be soged, ar Bab-Dummadbi unnila wargwennaa gued, ayobid baid sated.

Bab-Dummadga bela ibmar-ogumakar-ukedba, degi, ibmar-baigan-ega-ukedba, bur-biriginedid, bela-belad gwagegi Bab-Dummad-sabgued, mag-ito-guedgi sabgued, san-burbagi sabgued, ganguedgi sabgued, degi, na be-san-sabgueyob dule-baid-sabgued.
Jesús, Garda-Narmaked-Dule nue-binsaed-nikaa e-abin-imaksa-itosgu, ega sogded: —Bab-Dummad-negdakmaidgi be dikasur gudisulid. A-sorbali, Jesúsʼse dule-baid bar-gwen-ibmar-egisbi itossurmalad.
Wede Cristo, ¿doa-machisunna?
Jesús, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi dulemar-odurdaksigu, sogded: —Garda-Narmaked-Dulemar, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsadnik sogmalad, a-dule, Rey-David-e-machiye.
Ar Rey-David-sunnaddi, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledba, sogsagusad:

content.text: be-isdarmalad an bela ogalakuedse be sige.’

content: Salmo 110:1
”Ar David-sunnad ‘Dummadye’ ese goled, degite, ¿Cristo igi e-machiga gubarsunnoe?” Dulemar-bukidar bela nue-yeer Jesús-itobukwa gusmalad.
Jesús Garda-Narmaked-Dulemargi sunmaksad

Jesús dulemar-odurdakdebali, sogded: —Garda-Narmaked-Dulemargi nue salakarmar. Amardi, mor-oyaarmakdiir na yeer-itodamalad, degi, dulemar bela ese ibmar-ukleged-neggi-goledbimalar, yeer-itodamarbalid.
Amar Judíoʼmar-onmakedneggi dule-dummagan-gan-sigedginbi sigbidamalad, degi, mas gullealir, dummagan-gan-sigedginbi sigbidamarbalid.
Omegan-ei-sui-burgwismalad-ibe ibmar susdamalad, deginbali, dulemar yeer e-dakegala, yamo suitii Bab-Dummadse gorgwisdamarbalid. Ar amar bur bule sabsur-odurdaklemaloed.
Ome-ei-sui-burgwisad Bab-Dummadga-e-mani-uksad

Jesús Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi, bia mani-Bab-Dummad-ukleged-e-ulu-siid-asabin signonikid. Agi, daksigualid, igi dulemar ulu-yagi mani-urbenonidamala. Bukidar mani-ibgan ulu-yagi mani-ichesur egwadnonidamalad.
Agine, ome-ei-sui-burgwisad-wileged-wargwen nonimogad, geb mani-esnon-gwabo wis egwachad.
Geb Jesús na e-sapinganse gochad, ega sogded: “Napira an bemarga soged, we-ome-ei-sui-burgwisad-wileged bur bule ulu-yagi dule-baiganba mani-egwachad.
Ar dule-baigandi, mani-ei-gwabgusad egwachamalad. Ar we-omedi, na e-wilesagwadgine bela-mani-nika-gudiid egwachad. We-maniginbi gudiinad.”
